title: Adventure q(≧▽≦q) Chapter ヾ(≧▽≦)o Unlocked
description: Enter a new biome record and display a message!
body:
# What can it do?
It's just a decoration, not very useful, but it can make your modpack more advanced (maybe).
## How to use?
After entering the biome, a message will be displayed in Chinese (I only know how to hard code it).
Press B+L to open the progress interface, which will display the biomes you have walked through, the number of biomes you have walked through, and the unlocked milestones.
### Compatibility with other mods
It must be compatible.
